items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued September 14 at 9:48PM EDT until September 15 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...Breaking waves of 3 to 5 ft and onshore flow will
result in rough surf conditions and a high risk of rip
currents.

* WHERE...In North Carolina, Eastern Currituck County. In
Virginia, Virginia Beach.

* WHEN...From 8 AM EDT Tuesday through Tuesday evening.

* IMPACTS...A high risk of rip currents and rough surf is
expected.
items.instruction: Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 15 at 12:43AM EDT until September 15 at 6:00PM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and
seas 4 to 6 ft.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from NC VA border to Currituck Beach
Light NC out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 6 PM EDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
